chat_history.message: I am unaware of any existing country labeled or commonly referred to as "BOTFather."
BotFather in Telegram, from which country is its developer

Telegram is developed by brothers Nikolai and Pavel Durov. They are Russian nationals but have been living in self-imposed exile in Dubai for a number of years, primarily due to their inability to return to their home country owing to the political and legal issues they have had with the Russian government.

Telegram is administered by a nonprofit organization called the Telegram Foundation, which is registered in London, England. However, the operational center for Telegram is in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
